claim.text: The hazard became present at 6.13 s by closing within the ego lane, and impact occurred at 8.00 s, 1.87 s later.
Perception delay was 0.18 s (first seen at 6.31 s vs hazard onset at 6.13 s), below the 0.30 s perception threshold.
Command delay was 0.05 s (brake request at 6.36 s vs first seen at 6.31 s), below the 0.10 s command threshold.
Brake actuation delay was 0.14 s (pressure reached at 6.50 s vs CAN brake request at 6.36 s), below the 0.25 s actuation threshold.
Brake log is complete, so the timing analysis is not inconclusive.
Counterfactual with nominal perception 0.20 s, command 0.05 s and tau 0.15 s still results in contact.
